submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 6mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.102% at 100 GeV across all tested configurations. This represents a ~39% improvement over the best F1 configuration (5.06%) and ~19% improvement over the best F3 configuration (3.813%). The 6mm thickness is well within the required 2-10mm range and represents the optimal balance for sampling calorimetry with this material. F2's shorter radiation length (0.63 relative to F1) enables better electromagnetic shower sampling, leading to superior energy resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 6mm achieves 3.102% resolution, which is the best result among all 18 configurations tested (3 materials × 6 thicknesses)

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) identified and tested

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: Material activation properties were not explicitly evaluated in the simulation results, though this is a critical safety constraint that should be verified from material specifications
Recommended thickness of 6mm falls within the specified 2-10mm range
